findings.claim: The MCP server name is still resolved at module import time, not at call time.
findings.evidence: The acceptance criteria explicitly require runtime identity values to be "resolved at call time not import time" and Round 2 says "MCP server name now resolved at call time (apps/daemon/src/mcp.ts)", but the hunk defines `const SERVER_NAME = defaultMcpServerName();` at top level.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the top-level constant with a function or resolve `defaultMcpServerName()` inside the MCP server creation/start path after the build profile is guaranteed to be applied.

findings.claim: The Open Design daemon package now unconditionally installs a `knowdesign` CLI alias even when the profile is off.
findings.evidence: The acceptance criteria require "Open Design stays the default" and focus on distinct CLI names, but the hunk changes the static package bin map from only `"od": "./bin/od.mjs"` to also include `"knowdesign": "./bin/od.mjs"` with no profile gating.
findings.suggested_fix: Generate or patch the bin map only for KnowDesign packaging, or use separate package metadata for the KnowDesign build so the default Open Design package does not claim the `knowdesign` command.
